mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production indicates weakening manufacturing activity that precedes economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises, or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in annualized CPI inflation above 3.0% signals impending monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.07) indicate monetary policy misstep that erodes corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS <= 0.07, or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a growth phase (annual GDP growth > 2.0%), a decline in retail sales indicates weakening consumer spending that precedes economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during growth phases when RSAFS declines, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.04.
